title: USB-to-UART Interface with 3.3V LDO
task_description: Design a simple USB-to-UART interface board. Use CH340 as the USB-to-UART bridge and XC6206 as a 3.3V regulator derived from the USB 5V input. The board exposes TXD and RXD as the UART interface.

component_list.description: 3.3V LDO regulator for USB-powered logic rail

title: LDO Regulator with Voltage Supervisor
task_description: Design a regulated 3.3V power output stage. 5V input, fixed 3.3V output. Use AMS1117-3.3 as the regulator and TPS3703 as a voltage supervisor. The supervisor monitors the 3.3V output rail and provides a POWER_GOOD signal.

title: LED Constant-Current Driver
task_description: Design a high-power LED constant-current driver. 12V-24V input, driving a 1W LED at 350mA. Use PT4115 as the LED driver.

title: Two-Stage Audio Amplifier
task_description: Design a compact audio amplifier. Single 9V supply, overall voltage gain about 100x-200x, driving an 8-ohm speaker. Use NE5532 as a low-level preamplifier stage and LM386 as the final power amplifier stage. The NE5532 output feeds the LM386 input.

component_list.description: Dual low-noise operational amplifier used as preamplifier

title: Environmental Monitoring Terminal with Display
task_description: Design an environmental monitoring terminal. STM32F103 MCU reads BME280 sensor and drives SSD1306 OLED display, both on a shared I2C bus. 5V input, AMS1117-3.3 provides 3.3V system power.

title: IMU Data Logger
task_description: Design an inertial data logger. ATmega328P MCU reads MPU-6050 6-axis IMU via I2C and logs data to W25Q64JV Flash via SPI. 5V input, ME6211 provides 3.3V system power.

title: USB Development Board with EEPROM Storage
task_description: Design a USB development board. CH32V003 RISC-V MCU as main controller, CH340 provides USB-to-UART bridge, AT24C256 EEPROM stores configuration data. USB 5V input, XC6206 provides 3.3V system power.

title: CAN Bus Node
task_description: Design a CAN bus communication node. STM32F103 communicates with MCP2515 standalone CAN controller via SPI, which connects to SN65HVD230 CAN transceiver for differential bus access. 5V input, AMS1117-3.3 provides 3.3V system power.

title: RS485 Modbus Node
task_description: Design an RS485 Modbus communication node. GD32F103 connects to SP3485 RS485 transceiver via UART, and to W25Q128JV Flash via SPI for communication logging. 5V input, AMS1117-3.3 provides 3.3V system power.

title: Triple-Rail Power Supply with Single-Rail Power-Good Monitor
task_description: Design a triple-rail power board without an MCU. A 12V input is converted to 5V, then to 3.3V, then to 1.8V in a three-stage cascade. Use one LM393 comparator channel to monitor the 3.3V rail and generate a POWER_GOOD signal. Tie the unused LM393 comparator channel inputs to ground.

component_list.description: Dual comparator; use channel 1 for VCC_3V3 monitor, tie channel 2 inputs to GND

title: DC Motor Driver with Current Sense Feedback
task_description: Design a single-channel DC motor driver. STM32F103 controls TB6612FNG channel A using AIN1, AIN2, PWMA, and STBY. Use a low-side shunt for motor current sensing; INA128 senses the two shunt terminals and outputs to an STM32 ADC. VIN_MOTOR is external; VIN_5V feeds AMS1117-3.3 for VCC_3V3. Use common GND, not isolated grounds.

title: Single-Channel Audio Preamplifier with DAC Bias Control
task_description: Design a single-channel audio preamplifier. ATmega328P controls MCP4725 over I2C. MCP4725 VOUT provides a bias/control voltage to the NE5532 channel-1 non-inverting input network. Use NE5532 channel 1 as a non-inverting amplifier; tie unused channel-2 inputs to a safe bias state and leave its output unused. VIN_5V powers the analog stage; AMS1117-3.3 powers ATmega328P and MCP4725. Use common GND.

title: LED Matrix Display Controller
task_description: Design an LED matrix display controller. STM32F103 drives MAX7219 LED driver via SPI. MAX7219 cascades to 74HC595 shift register for output expansion. 5V input, AMS1117-3.3 powers the MCU. Note: MAX7219 and 74HC595 require 5V supply.

title: Precision ADC Readout with Reference Monitoring
task_description: Design a precision ADC readout board. STM32F103 reads ADS1115 via I2C. ADS1115 measures one external analog input and also monitors REF5050 output as a precision reference/calibration voltage. VIN_5V powers REF5050 and feeds AMS1117-3.3, which provides 3.3V for STM32F103 and ADS1115. Use common GND with analog/digital star-ground intent.

component_list.description: 5.0V precision voltage reference monitored by ADC

title: Flight Controller Core
task_description: Design a flight controller core board. A 5V input feeds TPS54331 to generate a 3.3V digital rail and ME6211 to generate a separate 3.3V analog/sensor rail. STM32F427 connects to MPU-6050 IMU via I2C, and to BMP280 barometer and W25Q128JV black-box Flash via shared SPI with separate chip-select signals. Use common GND with analog/digital star-ground intent. Keep the digital 3.3V and analog 3.3V rails distinct, but do not galvanically isolate grounds.

title: Battery-Powered IoT Gateway
task_description: Design a battery-powered IoT gateway. USB-C 5V connects to CP2102N for debug UART and to TP4056 for Li-ion charging. TP4056 charges the battery, DW01A protects the battery, and the protected battery node feeds ME6211 to generate 3.3V. ESP32-WROOM-32E is the main controller and reads BME280 over I2C. Do not implement full USB/battery load-sharing or power-path ORing.

title: Dual Stepper Motor Controller
task_description: Design a dual stepper motor controller. STM32F103 MCU connects to two TMC2209 stepper drivers via UART (different addresses) and to W25Q64JV Flash via SPI for motion parameter storage. 12V-24V motor power input, TPS54331 steps down to 5V, AMS1117-3.3 steps down to 3.3V. High-voltage motor supply and low-voltage logic supply are separate rails but share common GND. Do not create galvanic isolation.

title: Stereo Audio Playback System
task_description: Design a stereo audio playback system. USB_5V powers PAM8403 directly and feeds AMS1117-3.3 for ATmega328P and MCP4725. MT3608 boosts USB_5V to 9V only for the NE5532 preamplifier stage. ATmega328P controls MCP4725 over I2C. MCP4725 VOUT provides a shared GAIN_CTRL or bias-control signal to the NE5532 stereo preamp. NE5532 left/right outputs feed PAM8403 left/right inputs, and PAM8403 drives stereo speakers. Use common GND with analog/digital star-ground intent. Do not require a complete voltage-controlled gain circuit.

title: Branched Multi-Rail Power Management Board
task_description: Design a multi-rail power management board without an MCU. A 12V input feeds TPS54331 to generate 5V. The 5V rail feeds TPS61088 to generate a boosted 12V load rail, AMS1117-3.3 to generate 3.3V, and ME6211 to generate 1.8V from 3.3V. TPS3703 monitors the 5V rail and outputs POWER_GOOD. Use simple always-on enable connections where required.

component_list.description: Single-channel voltage supervisor monitoring the 5V rail

title: Galvanically Isolated Precision ADC Node
task_description: Design a galvanically isolated precision ADC node. VIN_5V powers XC6206, STM32F103, and the MCU-side ISO7721 supplies. External ISO_5V powers REF5050 and a second XC6206, which generates ISO_3V3 for ADS1118 and the isolated-side ISO7721 supplies. REF5050 VOUT connects to one ADS1118 analog input. ISO7721 devices isolate STM32F103↔ADS1118 SPI, including ADS1118 return data. GND and ISO_GND must never connect.
